title: Impeachment court ‘fully prepared to defend’ voting threshold in Duterte trial: spokesperson
summary: The Senate impeachment court said Friday that it was “fully prepared to defend” its ruling lowering the number of votes needed for a conviction in Vice President Sara Duterte’s trial.
